name: Minimax H3 Max (image-to-video)

access.regionNotes: Accessed through the Atlas Cloud aggregation API, not directly from the model vendor.

notes: Both local runs requested 9:16 and both returned 480x640, which is 3:4. This is a measured request-versus-output mismatch, not an inference.
Requested duration was 5 seconds; measured outputs were 10.33 s (after palindrome post-processing) and 5.17 s.
promptExpansion was set to false in both runs. Behaviour with prompt expansion enabled has not been tested here.
